title: WDL REGISTRY v2.1
description: A REGISTRY object. Each key other than $version and __tokens__ is a semantic id. An entry is a utility class string, an HTML attribute object, or a structured entry. Utility keys become the class attribute. rules and variant css objects become @scope (.semantic_id). Unknown keys on a structured entry are copied onto the element as HTML attributes. scopes is rejected: the compiler does not emit it.

selector.description: Selector inside the scope. :scope is the semantic id element. & .child is a descendant. Omitted selector means :scope.

media.description: Media query text without the @media keyword, for example (min-width: 768px).

oneOf.description: Utility classes stamped on the element when this variant is active.
v1 utility class string. Stamped onto the element class.

uses.description: Parent semantic ids merged before this entry. rules arrays are concatenated. Other maps merge by key.

base.description: Utility classes always stamped on this element.

defaultVariant.description: Active variant name. The compiler also writes data-variant to this value.

states.description: Pseudo-class name to utility classes. The key is prefixed onto every class: hover + shadow-lg becomes hover:shadow-lg. A class that already starts with hover: is left as written.

breakpoints.description: Screen name to utility classes. The key is prefixed onto every class, including one that already has another prefix: md + hover:bg-blue becomes md:hover:bg-blue. A class that already starts with md: is left as written.

containers.description: Container query name to utility classes, using the same prefix rule. @md + flex-row becomes @md:flex-row.

rules.description: Scoped CSS compiled to @scope (.semantic_id). The HTML tag is not part of the selector.

vars.description: Global tokens compiled to :root custom properties.
